title: Nature journal demo: a sloth bear entry
storyboard: Film: top-down of a hand writing and sketching this sloth bear entry in a nature journal, 3 close-ups

scenes.headline: One sighting, three lines in your journal
Bor Tiger Reserve. Sloth bear mother, two cubs on her back.
Shaggy black coat, pale snout, mouth open
Cubs stay with mum for 2-3 years and often ride on her back
Learn field journalling on a tiger-reserve trip

caption:
Your best wildlife photo is the one you wrote down

Sloth bears can close their nostrils at will, which keeps dust out while they suck termites from a nest.

Source: Britannica, Animal Diversity Web. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Demo of the cheapest field gear there is - a notebook - using a where/noticed/looked-up template; every line matches what the wild photos (Bor, Ranthambore) actually show.
